explanation: How adding an Antigravity account will work from your phone. The machine runs agy in the background; you only see the link and paste the code. It leaves out the one-time live check the build starts with.

events.label: Add Antigravity account
events.detail: The machine starts agy out of sight and picks Google sign-in for you

events.label: Link appears
events.detail: Open it on any device and sign in to Google

events.label: Paste the code
events.detail: The machine types it into agy

events.label: Account shows signed in
events.detail: The machine closes its agy and checks the login
